title: The effect of the permeability in interface problems: impermeable barriers and free diffusion
summary: Focusing on reaction-diffusion models with an interface region dividing the domain, we study the stability of systems as the permeability parameter approaches zero or infinity under Kedem-Katchalsky boundary conditions imposed on the membrane or interface region. These boundary conditions establish that the flux across the interface manifold is proportional to the density jump across that region, with the constant of proportionality defined as the permeability parameter. We analyze both limiting behaviors: when permeability vanishes and when infinite flux is permitted. This analysis is…
